title: Pack for the day ahead
subtitle: Three kits for different kinds of fieldwork. Illustrative equipment and prices for template examples.

items.name: Day Survey
items.summary: Notebook, measuring tape, compass, and a weatherproof pouch for short surveys.

items.name: Evening Watch
